The merit of sportspersons who fulfil the eligibility conditions will be considered/decided in the following order of preference:
First preference to those candidates who have represented the country in an International Competition with the clearance of the Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/U.T. in the Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by the National Sports Federations recognized by Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports or National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Between the candidates participating in Senior and Junior National Championships/games

the candidates having participated and won a medal in Senior National Championship should be given preference. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board or Khelo India University Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) or Khelo India Winter Games or Khelo India Para Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented the State Schools in the National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Next preference may be given to those who represented a State/Union Territory/University/State Schools Teams at the level mentioned in categories 2 to 5 above but could not win a medal or position
in the same order of preference.
Note 1: In the event of a tie

those who have secured a higher position or won more than one medal may be given the preference. Note 2: Participation in individual and team event/item may be given the same preference. Note 3: No preference may be given for winning more than one medal/position. Note 4: In case of any doubt about the status of a tournament
the matter will be decided by the Department of Personnel & Training in consultation with the Department of Sports
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
how_to_apply: The notification does not provide an online application link. Eligible applicants may send their applications in the prescribed proforma either by post or by hand. Candidates should check https://www.cbic.gov.in and https://ccolkozone.gov.in regularly for updates.
Read the notification, eligibility criteria, instructions to candidates, vacancy positions and other conditions carefully before filling up the application form.
Fill in the application form as per Annexure-A in black ink in capital letters, with all required details.
Affix a recent colour passport size photograph in the space provided on the application form.
Indicate the post applied for (Tax Assistant, Havaldar or Both). If applying for both posts in a single application form, mention the first and second preference of the posts.
Enclose self-attested copies of all the required documents and the relevant sports certificate forms (Form-1 to Form-5, whichever is applicable).
Sign the declaration and put the application in a closed cover superscribed with the words “Application for Meritorious Sportsperson in CGST & Central Excise Lucknow Zone 2026”.

Send the cover by post or by hand so that it reaches the address below by 23.11.2026 (17:00 hrs). Applicants domiciled in North Eastern states, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh get another ten (10) days.
The application form in Annexure-A asks for the following details:
Post applied for (Tax Assistant, Havaldar or Both) and the preference for the post, if applied for both
Full name in Hindi and in English; father’s name; gender (Male/Female/Third gender)
Permanent residential address and address for communication
Date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY) and age as on 23.11.2026
Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST) and whether a PwBD candidate (Yes/No; if yes, the category)

Level of representation in games/sports (International, National, Inter-University, Khelo India, any other event) with the number of medals awarded and the position earned/represented, along with the latest performance in sports
Documents submitted (self-attested) – tick the enclosed documents
Telephone/mobile number, e-mail ID (if any), Aadhaar number and details of the present employer, if any

The form also carries a declaration that all statements are true, complete and correct, that no other application has been submitted for the post, that there is no ongoing investigation regarding doping or unfair means in any sporting event, and that the applicant fulfils the age, educational qualification and sports eligibility conditions. It must be signed by the applicant with place, date and full name.
important_instructions: The applicant must possess the requisite educational qualification for the post on the closing date of submission of the application form. The cut-off date for determining age and other eligibility criteria is 23.11.2026. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere under the jurisdiction of Cadre Control Authority Lucknow (Lucknow Zone and Meerut Zone, spread over Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand). Selected candidates will be under probation for 2 years or such period as per the extant instructions of the Government of India. They will be required to represent the Central GST, Central Excise and Customs, Lucknow Zone including Meerut Zone, in the tournaments/meets as decided by the office. In the event of any tie, the decision of the appointing authority will be final. The Chief Commissioner of CGST & Central Excise, Lucknow Zone (CCA) has the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Any form of canvassing by a candidate will render the candidature liable to be rejected summarily at any stage of the recruitment process. If at any stage the candidate is found to have furnished any wrong information, statement or declaration, or falsified/misrepresented any facts, the candidature/appointment will be liable for cancellation. The recruitment is subject to applicable rules for recruitment of meritorious sportspersons issued by the Government of India from time to time.

content_sections.heading: CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be considered, a candidate must satisfy the age limit, the educational qualification for the post applied for, and the sports eligibility conditions. The educational qualification must be held on the closing date of submission of the application form. The candidate must be 18 to 27 years of age on 23.11.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit by five (5) years is allowed in each case. In addition, a further relaxation of five years is allowed only to candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) in each case. A total of 10 years of age relaxation is therefore allowed to SC/ST candidates only. Although the additional age relaxation is provided to SC/ST candidates, the notification states that no post shall be reserved for any category of candidates. Age relaxation is admissible only to sportspersons who satisfy all other eligibility conditions related to education and sports qualifications, backed by a certificate in the prescribed form from the authority detailed in the notification. Appointment can be made of a sportsperson considered meritorious with reference to the following criteria. The sportsperson should have represented: A State or the country in a National or International competition; or medal winners in Junior National Championships; or medal winners in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years); or Khelo India Winter Games; or Khelo India Para Games; or medal winners in Khelo India University Games; or medal winners in School Games Federation of India (SGFI), in any of the games/sports mentioned in the DoPT Office Memorandum No. DOPT-1720781414772 dated 04.03.2024. Their University in the Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards in any of the sports/games specified in the same DoPT Office Memorandum. The State School Teams in the National Sports/games for schools conducted by the All India School Games Federation in any of the games/sports mentioned in the same DoPT Office Memorandum. For Chess: Grand Master (GM) Title, International Master (IM) Title, Chess Olympiad. IM/GM title should be in Open Category like Woman Grandmaster (WGM) etc. While National Open Chess Championship is treated as National Championships, the medal winning performance in National Team Chess Championship will also be considered for recruitment. Only certificates awarded by the authorities listed below will be taken into account as evidence of participation in competitions. The applicant may submit self-attested copies of at least one merit certificate issued by one of these authorities along with the application. The applicant must submit Forms 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 (whichever is applicable), complete in all respects. Specimens of these forms are given in Annexure B of the notification. Certificates of sports achievements submitted in any other form, or from authorities other than those listed above, will be ignored.
